slides.title:
Harbour
water, Q3
slides.byline: Field report for the city council

slides.label: Summary
slides.title: The harbour is the cleanest it has been since we started measuring, and *one outfall* is the reason it isn't cleaner.

slides.label: Clarity
slides.title: Visibility keeps *rising*
slides.text: Average depth at which a white disc disappears, across 12 sampling points. Higher is clearer.
slides.source: Field Lab sampling, June–August each year

items.heading: Clarity
items.text: Best summer reading in six years of sampling.

items.heading: Nitrogen
items.text: Down since the 2024 upgrade at the east plant.

items.heading: Problem outfall
items.text: Point 7 at Nordnes still fails after heavy rain.

slides.label: Point 7
slides.text: rain events this summer pushed *Point 7* over the bathing-water limit within 24 hours.
slides.source: E. coli counts, EU bathing water directive

slides.label: Recommendations
slides.title: Fix one outfall, keep the rest going.
items: Fund a storm-water tank at Nordnes in 2027
Keep weekly sampling at Point 7 year round
Publish readings online the day they're taken
